summary: Learn to assess readiness, guide adoption and sustain workplace change with practical frameworks. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Sustainable change leadership helps people responsible for workplace change keep new practices in use after rollout. It is designed for change leads, operations managers and sustainability coordinators, and covers assessing readiness, clarifying roles and influence, planning transition support, and using review measures to track adoption and outcomes. Learners also develop a change baseline and a sustainment plan using frameworks such as Lewin’s model and the PDCA cycle.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who lead or support workplace changes and need to keep adoption moving after initial rollout. It suits foundation-level learners who can bring a team, process or change initiative as a working example.
modules: Outcome Logic with Theory of Change
Transition Support with Bridges and ADKAR
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Basic familiarity with a workplace team, process or change initiative will help you apply the exercises. No prior change-management qualification is expected. Programming: Coding is not required.
